content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education Campus Wilhelminenhof campus Wilhelminenhof campus Table of contents Address & contact information Security and campus emergency call Map Download map Public transport Opening hours Address & contact information Wilhelminenhofstraße 75A, 12459 Berlin Telephone: (030) 5019 - 0 Fax: (030) 5090 134 Security and campus emergency call at the Information Centre in Building B, telephone: 5019-3000 Map i Information, Emergency Entrance (Protection from racial attacks) Building A Dean’s Office Faculty 5 Building B Teaching Support Center, Halls 1-4, University Sports (hall 4), Central Student Union (AStA), Faculty Student Council, International Office, Centre for Student Advisory and Careers Service Building C Dean’s Offices Faculties 1, 2, 4, Computer Museum, IDiA Maker Space, AI Lab Building D Halls 5-7, Faculty 2 Building E Faculty 2 Building F Faculties 1 and 2 Building G Library, canteen (Mensa), lecture theatres, Student Service Centre, coffee bar, Faculty 1 Building H Centre for Research and Professional Development in Culture and Information Technology (FKI), Urban Garden (meadow beside building H) HdT House of Transformation TGS TGS Technology and Start-up Centre Schöneweide (Faculty 4 and 5, Computer Centre, Foreign Languages Centre), Ostendstr. 25, 12459 Berlin Download map Wilhelminenhof campus [PDF] Public transport Tram Lines 27, 60 and 67 to Rathenaustraße/HTW BVG public transport timetable information Bikesharing or on foot You only need a few minutes by bike from S Schöneweide. You can hire bikes from nextbike (bike sharing) at Schöneweide S-Bahn station and return them on the campus. From Schöneweide S-Bahn station, you can reach the campus on foot via the ‘Kaisersteg’ in approx. 20-25 minutes. Opening hours Monday to Friday : 6.30 a.m. to 10.00 p.m. Saturday : 6.30 a.m. to 6.00 p.m. (with access card) Between Christmas and New Year all HTW Berlin buildings are closed.
